clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 13(a): either Party may prevent automatic renewal by giving the other Party written notice before the stated deadline.
clauses.condition_explanation: party_intends_not_to_renew means the Party elects not to renew; current term means the Initial Term or then-current Renewal Term, as applicable. Use is the closest available activity for giving notice.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 13(b): either Party may terminate the Agreement at any time via the Website.
clauses.condition_explanation: Termination is available to either Party at any time and must be effected via the Website. Use is the closest available activity for termination.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 13(c): either Party may terminate if the other Party materially breaches and fails to correct the breach within 15 calendar days after receiving notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: The termination right requires a material breach, notice to the breaching Party, and failure to correct within the 15-calendar-day cure period. Use is the closest available activity for termination.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 13(d): on expiration or earlier termination, Customer must immediately cease accessing or using the Cohere API SaaS Services.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies immediately upon either expiration or earlier termination.

obligation_items.content: Immediately cease accessing and using the Cohere API SaaS Services.
obligation_items.trigger: Upon expiration or earlier termination of the Agreement.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 13(d): at Customer’s request, Cohere will delete or render inaccessible remaining Customer Data, including Custom Models. The stated duty does not apply to API Data or Finetuning Data submitted in accordance with Section 3(a)(iii).
clauses.condition_explanation: The request must be made within 30 calendar days following termination. Deletion or inaccessibility is required upon a timely request; the specified Section 3(a)(iii) data is excepted. Use represents the data-handling action; the precise action and object are stated in the obligation.

obligation_items.content: At Customer’s timely request, delete or otherwise render inaccessible Customer Data remaining in hardware or systems used to provide the Cohere API SaaS Services, including Custom Models.
obligation_items.object: Customer Data remaining in Cohere service hardware or systems, including Custom Models, excluding API Data or Finetuning Data submitted in accordance with Section 3(a)(iii).
obligation_items.trigger: Agreement termination and Customer request within 30 calendar days following termination; no deletion or inaccessibility duty for the specified Section 3(a)(iii) API Data or Finetuning Data.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 14(a): notices are effective upon written in-person or email delivery, one day after sending by overnight courier, or five days after prepaid first-class mail is sent to the recipient’s designated official contact. Use represents giving notice.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed delivery methods are alternatives. Effectiveness depends on the method and its stated timing; notices must be sent to the designated official contact. Specific contact details continue in lines 345–350 and 352.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 14(a): Customer is responsible for keeping its postal or email contact information on file with Cohere current at all times during the Term. Use represents maintaining the notice contact information.
clauses.condition_explanation: The duty applies throughout the Term.

obligation_items.content: Keep Customer’s current postal or email contact information on file with Cohere.
obligation_items.object: Customer’s notice contact information on file with Cohere.
obligation_items.trigger: At all times during the Term.

clauses.scope_note: Cohere agreement, Section 14(a): Cohere may change its contact information by posting the new information on the Website or giving notice to Customer.
clauses.condition_explanation: The stated methods are alternatives. Use represents changing notice contact information.

coverage_notes: Lines 335–336 are liability limitations and are excluded as nonoperative for this activity-constraint extraction.

The available activities do not include termination, giving notice, or data deletion; Use is used as the closest representation where necessary, with precise actions stated in scope_note and obligation_items.
Section 3(a)(iii), referenced for the post-termination data exception, is not included; its contents are not inferred.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 335–336 contain excluded liability limitations; lines 338–344 contain modeled nonrenewal, termination, post-termination cessation and data handling, and notice-delivery provisions.
Line 347 supplies a postal address in the notice-address listing and creates no independent activity rule.
Line 350 supplies Cohere’s notice email address and creates no independent activity rule.
Line 352 permits Cohere to change its notice contact information by either of two methods and requires Customer to keep its contact information on file current during the Term.
